brief.meaningEn: An unwelcome task that continues, recurs, or seems as though it will never be finished.
brief.meaningZh: 持續或反覆出現、令人厭煩，感覺總也做不完的工作。
brief.grammar: a never-ending chore; never-ending chores; became/felt like a never-ending chore.
brief.register: Mildly informal and exasperated, with deliberate figurative exaggeration: a volunteer, colleague or housemate describes repetitive unwanted work to a teammate or friend; never-ending need not mean literally infinite.
brief.boundaryZh: 必須有「做完一部分又有下一部分」或似乎沒有終點的感覺；只做一次而且已完成的長工作，不適合。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是所有不喜歡的工作都是 never-ending chore；還需要持續、反覆或看不到完成的一面。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分「不喜歡做」與「感覺永遠做不完」，並在後者情境使用 a never-ending chore。

sources.sentence: Sorting receipts became a never-ending chore.

listening.en: Every Monday, Nora worked through the maintenance forms. New requests arrived before she finished the last pile, and by Friday it felt like a never-ending chore.
listening.zh: 每逢星期一，Nora 都要逐份處理維修表格。她還未清完上一疊，新申請就來了；到星期五，她覺得這成了沒完沒了的苦差。
listening.promptZh: Nora 說這是 a never-ending chore，語氣主要表達甚麼？

options.en: She is tired of a repeated task that seems to have no clear endpoint.
options.zh: 她厭倦了反覆出現、似乎沒有明確終點的工作。

options.en: She is pleased that each new request gives her more practice.
options.zh: 她很高興每次新申請都讓她多練習。

options.en: She knows with certainty that maintenance forms will arrive forever.
options.zh: 她確定維修表格在字面上會永遠送來。

options.en: She mainly wants to say that one form is unusually difficult.
options.zh: 她主要想說有一份表格特別難處理。

listening.explanationZh: 這是帶有厭煩的誇張說法：新申請不斷來，令工作像是做不完；並非聲稱它真的永遠持續。

reply.promptEn: Why does sorting the donation forms wear you out?
reply.promptZh: （整理捐款表格為何令你疲倦？）

options.en: New forms arrive as soon as I finish the last pile.
options.zh: 我剛處理完上一疊，新表格就到了。

options.en: I have to repeat the same checks every morning.
options.zh: 我每天早上都要重複同一套檢查。

options.en: It has become a never-ending chore.
options.zh: 它已變成沒完沒了的苦差。

options.en: There never seems to be a final batch.

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理說明疲倦原因；金句概括工作反覆湧來、似乎沒有終點的感覺。

scene.promptZh: 圖書館義工喜歡每週整理新書，卻厭煩每天反覆核對退回書籍的破損紀錄；剛處理完一批，下一批又到。哪句最貼切地說出令她厭煩的工作？

options.en: Checking the damage records has become a never-ending chore.
options.zh: 核對破損紀錄已變成沒完沒了的苦差。

options.en: Reshelving new books has become a never-ending chore.
options.zh: 整理新書已變成沒完沒了的苦差。

options.en: She completed a one-day damage audit and felt relieved it was over.
options.zh: 她完成了一天的破損紀錄檢查，對工作終於結束感到鬆一口氣。

scene.explanationZh: 新書整理雖然反覆，卻是她喜歡的事；令她厭煩而又不斷出現的是核對破損紀錄。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最能保留 a never-ending chore 的誇張語氣，而不是把 never-ending 當成字面上的「永遠」？

options.en: The weekly forms feel endless, even though we know the project will finish in June.
options.zh: 每週的表格工作令人覺得沒完沒了，儘管我們知道項目六月就會結束。

options.en: The forms will literally continue for an infinite number of years.
options.zh: 這些表格在字面上會無限期持續下去。

options.en: We finished the only form yesterday, and there will be no more.
options.zh: 唯一一份表格昨天已處理完，以後不會再有。

contrast.explanationZh: 這個表達說的是工作令人覺得總也做不完，可以是誇張說法；即使知道項目有結束日期，仍可如此描述當下感受。

dialogue.promptZh: Alex 說：「我今天清完電郵，明天又有一批；我一打開收件匣就覺得煩。」哪個回應最能先接住他的感受，而不是立即轉去給建議？

options.en: It sounds like a never-ending chore when the queue fills again each morning.
options.zh: 每天早上又有新郵件排隊，聽起來真是沒完沒了的苦差。

options.en: Try taking a break after each batch; that may help you concentrate.
options.zh: 每處理完一批就休息一下，可能有助你集中精神。

options.en: You could sort the messages by subject before you answer them.
options.zh: 你可以先按主題分類郵件，再逐一回覆。

dialogue.explanationZh: Alex 在訴說厭煩；金句先理解他覺得工作無休止的感受，另外兩句太快轉到方法建議。

speaking.en: When I call the daily expense checks a never-ending chore, I mean each new claim creates another round of work.
speaking.zh: 我說每天核對開支是沒完沒了的苦差，是因為每宗新申請又帶來下一輪工作。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽完整示範，再用英文說明這是帶誇張語氣的感受，不是聲稱工作真的永遠持續。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區菜園的義工每逢下雨後都要除草，剛整理完一區，下一週又有新雜草長出；他們已覺得厭煩。用一至兩句英文描述感受，並提出一項實際的分工或休息安排。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明工作令人厭煩、雜草反覆長出，並提出一項實際安排；正確使用本課表達。

examples.en: Weeding the shared beds became a never-ending chore because fresh weeds returned after every rain, so we set up a weekly rota.
examples.zh: 為共用種植區除草成了沒完沒了的苦差，因為每次下雨後又有新雜草長出，所以我們訂了每週輪值表。

examples.en: By the end of each week, the volunteers faced another patch of weeds, so the work felt like a never-ending chore; they planned shorter shifts.
examples.zh: 每到週末，義工又要面對另一片雜草，因此這項工作令人覺得沒完沒了；他們於是安排較短的更次。

takeaways.en: A task feels like a never-ending chore when new work arrives before the last round is done.
takeaways.zh: 一輪工作未完，新一輪又到，事情便令人覺得沒完沒了。

takeaways.en: Sorting the weekly returns became a never-ending chore, not just a long afternoon job.
takeaways.zh: 每週整理退貨變成沒完沒了的苦差，而不只是某個下午的長工作。
